# Trigger Notebook

This notebook is used to verify that the Fabric notebook content has been updated.

from datetime import datetime, timezone

TRIGGER_NOTEBOOK_VERSION = "1.1"
updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

print(f"Trigger notebook version: {TRIGGER_NOTEBOOK_VERSION}")
print(f"Executed at UTC: {updated_at}")
print("Fabric trigger notebook update test succeeded.")
